adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the code was changed to iterate `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (where `bookingCalendarReference` is now an array via `.filter(...)`). Inside that loop, when `bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings` is true, it runs a `promises = bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar).map(...)` that itself iterates credentials and deletes events for each `updBooking` (via `calendar?.deleteEvent(uid, evt, externalCalendarId)`). That recurring-deletion logic does not depend on the outer `reference` values (it doesn’t use `reference.uid/externalCalendarId` inside the branch), so for N calendar references it will execute the same bulk deletion N times, causing duplicate `deleteEvent` calls for the same updated bookings/calendars (likely leading to 404s on subsequent deletes). This matches the finding that the recurring branch belongs outside the outer loop.
